policy: Every owner-accepted behavior that has been physically commissioned or promoted to a commissioning acceptance invariant must remain bound to executable regression proof. Later refactors may change implementation internals, but they may not delete the invariant or its behavioral proof without an explicit owner-approved contract change.

invariants.title: Homeowner Hot Tub OFF ends only the current user session and preserves future Hot Tub autonomy
invariants.acceptance: A homeowner-started/adopted Hot Tub session may end with Spa OFF without arming persistent Autonomous Hot Tub suppression, even if BODY-adoption provenance has already retired while current same-epoch session evidence still identifies an active external-user Spa.

invariants.title: Pool Solar cold start from OFF/probe converges through preparation to H0002 at 2900 RPM
invariants.acceptance: From a quiescent Pool opportunity, PoolOS may activate Pool, acquire trustworthy water temperature at 1500 RPM, advance through the 2600-RPM Solar-preparation step, verify Solar/H0002 engagement, and converge at 2900 RPM while retaining PoolOS BODY/PUMP/THERMAL ownership.

invariants.title: Pool Solar target satisfaction shuts Pool OFF and pump to 0 when filtration is deferred
invariants.acceptance: When PoolOS-owned Pool Solar reaches or exceeds the Pool target and filtration does not independently require immediate circulation, Solar ends, Pool is commanded OFF, actual pump 0 is verified, the circulation owner is released, and future independent autonomy remains available.

invariants.title: Opportunistic Spa Solar yields cleanly to a fresh Pool Solar demand
invariants.acceptance: After Pool target satisfaction leaves the system idle, a qualified PoolOS opportunistic Hot Tub Solar session may start and converge at Solar/H0002 with 2900 RPM and PoolOS ownership. If a fresh Pool thermal demand then appears, the Hot Tub session must yield through source/body/pump cleanup, and a distinct new Pool generation must converge to Pool Solar/H0002 at 2900 RPM without stale cross-body ownership leakage.
